$comment: THE machine-readable Flash plugin protocol contract — the single source of truth. Normativity order: this file + the conformance specs > docs/plugin-protocol.md prose > the Rust SDK. Swift asserts its constants equal this file (PluginProtocolParityTests); the spec runner reads deadlines/quotas/errors from here; the Rust SDK hardcodes these values with a guardrail grep keeping them equal. Changing anything here is a protocol change: update the host, SDK, affected plugins, specs, and docs in the same commit (repo rule 9 — no compatibility shims, no version bump while Flash has no external users).

deadlines_ms.$comment: One deadline table. startup: initialize must be answered immediately (no warm-catalog wait; config [plugins] startup_timeout tunes it). query: per-keystroke evaluate. live: search + hints (late replies dropped, non-fatal). perform: all four kinds; a manifest commands[] entry timeout_ms overrides for that entry. ping: reply budget for the idle-liveness probe (sent only after idle_before_ping_ms of inbound silence with no request in flight; ONE miss tears down). shutdown_grace: stdin-close -> SIGTERM; +500ms -> SIGKILL.

host_to_plugin.initialize: request {protocol_version} -> {ok, protocol_version}; reply immediately, once ever; ok:false or a version mismatch is terminal (flush, exit 0)
host_to_plugin.evaluate: request {query, scope, surface} -> {ok, answers}; CPU-only over pre-warmed state
host_to_plugin.search: request {query, scope} -> {ok, rows}; live sources only, may do real work
host_to_plugin.hints: request {bundle_id, pid, front_window_frame} -> {ok, targets, context_pid?}; always live
host_to_plugin.perform: request {kind: resolve|command|action|navigate, ...} -> {ok, target_pid?, navigation_url?, message?} | {ok:false, unhandled:true} | {ok:false, error}

plugin_to_host_notifications.publish: {rows} — full-replacement catalog; host-owned store; empty rows = authoritative empty; transient failure = don't publish (host keeps last-good)

row.$comment: Catalog row shape for publish and search. `source` is first-class and must name a manifest sources[].name; routing source_id stays host-stamped and never crosses the wire.

effects.$comment: Closed union. copy_text/insert_text everywhere; open on rows only (answers cannot manufacture navigation). There is deliberately no run effect — argv side effects belong in perform, inside the sandbox.

quotas.$comment: Atomic rejection doctrine: any violation rejects the complete payload (a publish keeps the previous catalog; a reply serves empty); nothing is ever truncated.

errors.$comment: Canonical EXACT protocol-level error strings (spec-pinned; domain failures stay free-form and content-free). The response law: every result carries boolean `ok`; ok:false carries a non-empty `error` — except perform's {ok:false, unhandled:true} (not mine; host MAY fall back). A perform {ok:false, error} means mine-but-broke: the host MUST NOT fall back.
errors.protocol_mismatch: protocol version mismatch: host v<H>, plugin v1
errors.initialize_repeated: initialize may only be called once

id_semantics: positive monotonic integers per sender; host and plugin counters are independent and may overlap (an inbound id+method frame is always a request). Exactly one reply per id'd request. Responses to unknown ids are dropped silently. There is no cancellation: late replies are dropped and the deadline table is the contract.
encoding: UTF-8 JSON, one object per newline-terminated line both directions; geometry in NSScreen coordinates; undecodable or oversized lines are dropped (never fatal), the stream self-heals at the next newline
